goal: Make exact original-source byte slices available for one authorized teacher packet without exposing future days or whole parent files.
procedure: Rebuild every selected packet from pinned source inventory and original UTF-8 JSON files; locate exact source-native byte ranges in those originals; verify parsed values and fragment hashes; write a 0700 private directory holding 0600 deduplicated fragment blob, index and receipt. Pin the receipt digest outside the export call. Rehash receipt/index/blob, select exactly one packet ID privately and create a new 0600 teacher-visible export containing only that packet's exact fragment bytes, window and HMAC-derived opaque packet, host, source and slice handles. Resolve handles to original byte offsets only in private custody when constructing narrow evidence spans.
authority: Process seed for a published MFM method. MFM published documentation reports 1,920 packets, 102,240 source references and 58,560 unique fragments with a source-only private receipt; FBM has not independently mounted those private bytes. No source permission, external teacher disclosure, target or training authority is inferred.
validation: FBM seed JSON and trace structure checked locally. MFM method published at 22df35e; 20 focused source-slice and teacher-fit tests passed locally. The methods are absent from the 706f694 parent; FBM did not mount the owner-controlled private source slices.
failure_or_lesson: A whole 30-day structural file passed to a day-1 annotator leaks future evidence. An isolated packet must expose only exact contemporaneous source slices while preserving original-file offsets privately for later grounding.

goal: Preserve owner-authorized teacher supervision as legitimate training while keeping independent gold and product qualification separate.
procedure: Create a pinned v1.6 teaching manifest with complete source-grounded targets and all ten adjudication states, exact source/target and teacher prompt/response/conversion byte hashes, owner authorization, author and generator lineage, source permission for shared formation training and distribution, and diagnostic development isolated by connected ancestry. Check rights and target structure before optimizer handoff, but do not forge reviewer signatures or demand two human reviews for every synthetic gradient row. Process the full admitted teacher corpus on CPU, run a bounded full backward/restart probe, and fit the fresh specialist only after measured hardware readiness. Preserve teacher_fit and unqualified status in receipts; separately qualify with independently reviewed DEV and sealed FINAL, matched controls and downstream memory-to-judgment tests.
authority: Published code procedure only. Owner authorization permits attributed synthetic teaching but cannot authenticate third-party rights, lived history, independent development/FINAL or release competence. The old signed full-fit path remains available for separately authenticated gold.
validation: Compared current v1.6 admission/trainer policy with the earlier pinned MFM source receipt explicitly allowing synthetic training without dual manual review of every row. MFM method published at 22df35e and 20 focused tests passed locally; seed and trace JSON parse. No complete v1.6 teacher corpus, paid training or model result exists.
failure_or_lesson: Using gold-adjudication requirements as a per-row optimizer gate blocked owner-authorized teaching and confused training data with independent qualification. Separate exact-source rights and provenance checks for training from blind gold review and sealed capability assessment.
